name: after
text: The technology before this one in its menu slot: the menu shows it only after that research. train.unlocked.

name: age
text: The age of a technology (0 Dark, 1 Feudal, 2 Castle, 3 Imperial; build.AGE for the units and buildings). The menu shows it from that age on.

name: civ
text: The civilization of a unique technology: only its castle researches it (civs.MISSING of the others).

name: doctrine
text: A switch of the Recruitment Doctrines of its building (Macedonians): no queue and no cost, the next doctrine of the civ key "doctrines". train.DOCTRINES, train.switch.

name: effect
text: The change of the AoE2 combat values of a technology (train.effect: a dict, or a list of changes in turn). train.TECHS and train.EACH compute it; civs.MORE changes it.

name: faster
text: A unit that trains faster from an age: [age, its train time from that age] (the eagle scout and eagle warrior). train.seconds.

name: towers
text: Guard Tower and Keep: {tower: the tower of its values}, in the research order (file order). build.line.

name: walk
text: A technology that makes units walk faster: [the unit, a class of combat.STATS in lower case or a group of civs.GROUPS, the walk speed factor]. train.speed.

name: walls
text: A wall technology (Fortified Wall): {wall: the new wall}. The new and the complete own walls get the new design (build.design).
